headline: Brent Tops $100 as Morgan Stanley Warns Oil, Rates Are ‘Main Risks’ to Stocks
summary: Brent topped $100 as Morgan Stanley warned oil and rates are the main risks to stocks, while traders bet fighting eases this month.

headline: Chevron CFO Says Oil Giant Is ‘Bigger, Better and Stronger Than We’ve Ever Been’
summary: Chevron aims to double Venezuela oil production to 600K bpd while driving cost efficiency in U.S. shale and expanding globally.
